Amazing Hidden Gem
Jun 2018 • Couples
This is not something you'll find on the tourist map, which is surprising since it's in such a great location. The food was delicious and the prices were reasonable for what you get. Our combination pho was 79K, which is on the steeper side, but it had the most meat of any pho I've had in HCMC so trust me when I tell you it's well worth it. The place is down an alley and behind another building so it's a little tricky to find.

It's down a laneway so don't give up
Jun 2017 • Friends
After being in Saigon so many times since 94 I thought my friends had taken me to all the good places. No,found this one a few weeks ago. I have had so many bowls of Pho, I thought they can't come any better. Wrong. This place is a little gem. I can't wait to get back to Saigon and give the Menu a better work out. If you go, write the address down and give it to the Taxi driver. He will know . The place is down an alley way and you can walk right by. The sweets look fantastic but could not fit any in. Apparently, the model trains run right around the walls and over the tables. There was nothing happening when I was there. Maybe under repair.

Great food, friendly staff
Sep 2016 • Solo
I work down the street and regularly come here for lunch. They have a nice little set lunch menu with a few different options that come with soup and rice. I also get the pho tai frequently and it's very good -- nice and hot. All the staff members are friendly and accommodating, especially the owner/manager. They made a good ca phe sua da as well. Onverwachts erg lekker!
Aug 2016 • Family
We came from the warm museum and were a little bit hungry and thirsty. So we walked towards the big cathedral and came across this restaurant. The restaurant is behind in an alley so you need to pay attention if you want to find it. The staff is really friendly and all greet you with a big smile! We had the sweet and sour ribs, beef noodle soup and the meat spring rolls. All of it was really good and we ate more than we expected, since it just should've been a little snack. The lemon juice is really tasty and you get free ice tea! Happy to have stumbled upon this place

Great find, ask to sit out the back
Apr 2016 • Couples
Worth finding down the laneway, look for the street sign with the train. Husband had been there before on a work dinner and sat upstairs. The two of us went for lunch and the upstairs section was closed so they invited us out to the back garden. Beautiful covered area with a small waterfall feature. We had 2 claypots, large size, chicken thigh, 70000d and shrimp,5 big prawns, 85000d. Delicious, and served with complimentary iced tea. Would definitely go again to try other dishes.

Cafeteria that serve Pho
Jan 2016 • Friends
Very good location, on a quite street in the city center, next to many tourist sites. This is a cafeteria that serve a wide variety of food and one of those is Pho. The bad news is that they serve terrible Pho. The taste is just plain. I'm not sure why people get so excited about Pho at this cafeteria?!? It's place you come for a drink, finger food, ok. Definitely not a place you come for Pho. Have good indoor and outdoor seating.

Hidden Gem !
Nov 2015 • Couples
Great atmosphere, staff very nice and friendly, prices are reasonable. Decorations are awesome ( really cool model trains ). I tried the clay pot rice and the portion was HUGE, very delicious and flavourfull . The Pho had the right amount of noodles and meat, (some places rip you off with the meat).
All in all very great place to escape the busyness of Ho Chi Minh city and just relax :)
